name: mmlongbench_subset200
corpus: documents/<doc_id> in the HF dataset repo; NOT yet downloaded (subset needs 107 PDFs)
scope_note: Stratified random sample of 200 of 1091, seed 42, proportional allocation (largest remainder) over group x cross_page. group = 'unanswerable' if answer == 'Not answerable', else the single evidence type (text/table/chart/layout/figure), 'multiple' if >1 evidence types, 'unlabeled_evidence' if the raw evidence_sources is empty although the question is answerable (19 in full set). cross_page = len(evidence_pages) > 1 (matches the paper's ~33%). No must_contain: MMLongBench-Doc answers are typed (Int/Float/Str/List/None) and need the benchmark's own scorer or a judge, not substring matching. evidence_pages are 1-indexed.
